title: Marcos Is Hosting Trump on Grounds Where He Spent Much of His Childhood
summary_full: President Trump met the Philippine leader Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. at Malacañang Palace, which his family fled after his father was ousted from power 40 years ago.
summary_public: President Trump met the Philippine leader Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. at Malacañang Palace, which his family fled after his father was ousted from power 40 years ago.
